gaps: NOT COMPLETE: 67 selected combinations in 13 generation records; every version table remains partial. All 31 prior catalogue identities retained.

High-priority next: Mazda6 GG first-generation engines/gearboxes; Mazda3 BK missing MPS and more body-specific dimensions, BL missing diesel/MPS, BM final homologated values and later BN, BP older G122/G150/X180/diesels.
Mazda2 DY missing all tables; DE later diesel/automatic and DJ earlier75/90/115 updates not exhaustive. Mazda2 Hybrid has no technical rows.
323 FA/BD/BF/BG/BA/BJ and 626 all historical generations lack version tables; original 2002 UK323 brochure mirror returned403, so search snippets were not used to populate specifications.
MX-5 NA/NB/NC engine/gearbox combinations missing. CX-3, CX-5 KE/KM and CX-7 lack tables; CX-30 earlier G122/G150/X180 and CX-60 D200 absent. CX-80 only selected UK configurations.

Historic and global range is partial: Biante, Navajo, MS-8, Flair Wagon/Crossover and some LCV derivatives not yet independently resolved; Cosmo,929,MPV,B-Series andBT-50 require complete generation breakdowns.

RX-2 folded into626 alias, RX-4 into929/Luce alias, RX-5 intoCosmo alias, Lantis/323FBA into323 alias to avoid duplicate regional family cards. AutozamAZ-1 retained with explicit subsidiary-badge scope.
R360 end1966/1969 and Cosmo final1995/1996 scope conflicts leftnull; CX-8 global endnull because Japanese enddoes not settle overseas assembly.
Mazda3 BM selected values explicitly PRELIMINARY July2013 Europe excluding Russia. UK0–62mph/mph values remainnull; no unit conversion.
Consumption cycles leftunknown where exactCyprus sheet does not specify; displacement/cylinders and gearbox count are not inferred from marketing labels.
Photos are incomplete; category and subcategory searches were bounded, not exhausted. Tight crops/details/incorrect subjects were rejected.

photoSearch.method: Paced Commons imageinfo category batches with per-file exact Artist/LicenseShortName/LicenseUrl; accepted contact-sheet and individual thumbnails inspected. No photo/prose copied from marketplaces.

validation.checks: Unique production identities, scoped versions, exact Commons credits/aspects, indexed nulls and retained conflicts.

cleanup.retained: Structured independently selected facts, exact source URLs and Commons metadata, scripts/report; no downloaded documents, extracted source prose or preview images.
